description.value: Beginning at 4th level, a black mage can increase the potency of his next elemental spell as a swift action, so long as the casting time of the spell is 1 standard action or less. The next elemental spell the black mage casts deals half again as much damage as normal and any elemental resistance the target(s) of this spell has is lessen by half as well. He can use this ability once per day and every four levels thereafter, he gains an additional use. The use of this ability cannot be used with metamagic feats.
